schema.originalPrompt: A co-working space access system where members badge in with their own credentials, and front-desk staff can see who is currently in the building but never a member's full entry/exit history.

components.name: Member Login
components.purpose: Prompts a member for their badge number and access code.

components.name: Staff Presence View
components.purpose: Shows the current occupants of the building to staff, with no access to individual entry/exit logs.

components.name: Access Control API
components.purpose: Validates a badge number and access code, and records a check-in event.

components.name: Presence Service
components.purpose: Maintains a real-time list of currently present members, visible only to staff.

components.name: checkins table
components.purpose: Stores a check-in event per member, with no fields for full entry/exit history.

components.name: Access-Only-Entry Guard
components.purpose: Rejects any attempt to read or export the checkins table.

subject.phrase: the presence service's real-time occupant list.

constraints.rawText: Front-desk staff can see who is currently in the building, but never a member's full entry/exit history.
